name: Fluidframe
description: Create 3D device mockups, fluid shader gradients, and retro dithering; export 4K graphics and 60fps video directly in your browser.

paragraphs: Design high-impact 3D device mockups, real-time WebGL fluid mesh gradients, retro Bayer dither shaders, and render studio-grade 60 FPS MP4 videos & 4K snapshots directly in your browser — with zero server lag and 100% privacy.
Explore Live Demo (fluidframe.vercel.app) • Launch Editor • Report Bug
Most graphic design tools are either too basic or weighed down by bulky timelines, expensive subscriptions, and slow cloud rendering queues.
features: 🚀 100% Client-Side & Private: All WebGL rendering, dither calculations, and video transcoding happen directly on your machine via WebAssembly. Your images never leave your browser.
⚡ Instant Workflow: Zero setup, no account barrier, no paywalls. Open the editor and start crafting immediately.
🎬 Broadcast-Quality Exports: Export crisp 60 FPS MP4 videos, optimized GIFs, and Retina PNG / JPEG / SVG graphics in seconds.
